_comment: Texas 2026 QAP (10 TAC Chapter 11), Texas Department of Housing and Community Affairs. Page numbers are PDF page indices, one above the 'Page N of 217' footer. Competitive HTC scoring is §11.9 (pp.60-90); two point menus sit outside it in §11.101(b)(6)(B) and (b)(7) (see detail_external). NO TOTAL IS STATED. Competitive Applications scoring fewer than 120 points are ineligible (§11.101(b)(1)(A)(x), p.99). Hand-summed before loading from each paragraph's stated maximum: (b) 15 + 2 = 17; (c) 16 + 13 + 11 + 4 + 7 + 5 + 4 = 60, with Opportunity Index and the (d)(7) Concerted Revitalization Plan/Opportunity Zone mutually exclusive at 7 each; (d) 17 + 1 + 10 + 9 + 8 + 4 = 49; (e) 26 + 12 + 6 + 3 + 4 + 2 + 1 + 1 = 55. Total 181. The loader matched. Twenty-six of the 181 points are awarded to every eligible application (Financial Feasibility). The State Representative item runs from -8 to +8, and the (f) penalty is excluded.

track_totals.note: No total stated. Computed 181; the 120-point eligibility floor (p.99) is 66% of it. Every eligible application gets 26 for Financial Feasibility.
